answer: PoA binds each identity to bonded collateral and correlates equivocation across signing epochs. When k coordinated identities double-sign, pairwise slashing makes penalties grow as O(k^2), rather than linearly. Detection also triggers asymmetric capital depreciation: compounding loss applies an exponential multiplier, so controlling a sybil swarm is especially costly. Labels such as knoll, pearl, or canyon do not break the evidence linking identities.
